options.content:
## ECS/ContainerInsights Not Yet Active

The top panels use **`AWS/ECS`** (standard namespace — confirmed available in CloudWatch).

To enable per-container metrics (`CpuUtilized`, `MemoryUtilized` with `ContainerName` dimension), Container Insights must emit data to the `ECS/ContainerInsights` namespace.

**To activate, run:**
```
aws ecs update-cluster-settings \
  --cluster llm-ecs-cluster \
  --settings name=containerInsights,value=enhanced
```
Then restart all ECS services. Once metrics appear in CloudWatch, panels can be updated to use `ECS/ContainerInsights` with `ContainerName` and `AvailabilityZone` dimensions.
